src: the unique 3x3 checkerboard object; its adjacent guide pixel gives the path color
path: follow same-color guide pixels in horizontal/vertical two-cell steps
trajectory: path itself is not painted; it selects the ring at the reached endpoint
dst: the unique 3x3 ring object adjacent to the reached guide path endpoint
transform: crop and output that ring object unchanged
grid_shape: input is 22x22; output is the selected 3x3 ring
